summary: One journey id (r7-journey-20260923) connects every link on real infrastructure. The official papercusp-engineer 0.1.2 identity was published to Cupboard with a listed hash equal to a clone-first recompute. It was installed from that listing (release hash == listed) and resolved from the INSTALLED tier by a real headless agent whose launch receipt pins the installed document hash. That agent took fleet leadership (su.fleet-leader posture applied). It was then switched in the desktop UI with real X11 pointer input against the real backend: to research-steward, applied by the real host at gen 4, then back to the installed papercusp-engineer, applied at gen 5. The applied stack opened layer spans with a tool invocation recorded inside them. The 0.1.1->0.1.2 update diff was prompt-text only (10 files), with no grants and burn knobs [promptBytes].

links.evidence: After fleet:take-leadership in scratch fleet r7-journey-0923, the real host applied the su.fleet-leader posture: activation events 15459 desired -> 15479 prepared -> 15480 applied (gen 3, 2026-09-23T07:08:06Z), stack [autonomy:su.mode-auto, domain:papercusp-engineer, fleet-posture:su.fleet-leader].

In the Tauri desktop webview (headless verifier on display :90, SHARED database, real operator backend), the driver used real X11 pointer input to inspect research-steward, review it (preview 200), and apply it (switch 200, relaunch-with-carry). No synthetic host acknowledgement was posted, and the driver seeds and deletes nothing.

Activation 15811 (the installed identity) opened spans for all three layers on adv session 30010. A tool invocation by the subject (locks:check_command, id 29054027, at 2026-09-23T08:52:14.419Z) falls inside each of them. Spans were also opened for the research-steward stack (activation 15802, 08:49:24.881Z-08:52:14.270Z), and the subject's tool calls fell inside that window (locks:check_command 08:49:36Z, activity:report 08:49:53Z).

The in-journey update of the installed papercusp-engineer from 0.1.1 to 0.1.2 (operation update) returned a diff with promptText changes only: 10 files, all base/prompts/*. grants is [], and burnKnobs is [promptBytes], derived from the prompt-byte delta.

driverDefectsFixedDuringThisJourney: The first navigation pinned identityTab to the agent tab, but the identity rows render only on the default library tab, so the library assertion could never pass (runs 3-4). identitiesUrl() now carries no tab param; a unit test ties it to page.tsx's default.
A busy VERIFY_TAURI_SETTLE (exit 1) aborted the run (run 5). Settle is now recorded as best-effort (settleOutcome), and each dependent step polls its own target.
A real pointer click was swallowed with no request sent (run 6). clickUntil re-clicks only while no identity-management request has STARTED.
A response wait keyed on array length was pinned by an earlier run's orphaned request (runs 7-8). Responses are now matched by the start sequence number.
notProven: Relaunch mechanics: both applies kept adv_sessions 30010 (no new adv_sessions row), so this evidence shows the host applying the switch but not a separate successor native session per switch.

The receipt's package-kind input for papercusp-engineer (ade7aacdd2e11ce91a00929eb1362962538d77b916185b37f87fae1f9453e77a) is the install-tier recompute, which differs from the listing's clone-first package hash (492caab96ec34a4b62bda838229c80359de756bab7daea82f7e06867d6f76f6e). The listing-to-launch link is carried by the attested document hash c19c053c..., not by that package hash.

L6's qualifying tool call is locks:check_command, which the subject's PreToolUse hook issues for a command the agent ran. It is attributed to the subject's coord owner, but it is not a model-initiated MCP call. A coord:send wake asking the subject for one read-only call was sent at ~08:53Z, AFTER that invocation (08:52:14.419Z), so the wake did not produce the qualifying call.
su.fleet-member 0.1.2 was not re-published (Cupboard's 5/hour cap); it is not part of this chain.
Links L1-L4 and L7 were observed earlier in the same journey (07:00-07:08Z) and are cited by artifact; only L5-L6 are in this run's raw artifact.
